title: Lion King, The
description: Operation Pridelands is a video game inspired by The Lion King. It was released on March 11, 2004, by Disney Interactive Studios.

title: LIVE A LIVE
description:
Start your adventure today

A free demo of LIVE A LIVE is now available from Nintendo eShop! Get started in three different time periods – Imperial China, Twilight of Edo Japan and the Distant Future – and then transfer your progress to the full game.

You can download it from Nintendo eShop on your Nintendo Switch console, or via our website – just press the 'Download demo' button to get started!

The Legend is Alive

Many heroes, many stories, many lives to live! Discover a series of interwoven tales stretching throughout time, remastered in stunning HD-2D, with LIVE A LIVE on Nintendo Switch.

Forge a path through history

LIVE A LIVE features multiple characters to play as, with each chapter set in its own time period offering unique gameplay mechanics and locations. Who knows what awaits when all eight tales have been told?

Every time period features its own story and characters, with bespoke gameplay mechanics that make each one a unique experience.

Prehistory  The First

In a forgotten era, a young man comes of age and is given permission by the tribal elder to go forth and hunt. Bereft of words, he relies on his senses to survive; guided by his nose, he tracks game, finds shelter and learns of the dangers of the world.

Use your sense of smell to track wild beasts and craft weapons and armour with items you find.

Imperial China  The Successor

An old Chinese master nearing the end of his life yearns to preserve his kung fu for future generations. With this purpose, he ventures forth from his home atop Mount Aspiration, in search of a worthy successor to his legacy.

Focus your training efforts on any of your three disciples to choose them as the heir to your legacy.

Twilight of Edo Japan  The Infiltrator

In the shadows cast by the fires of chaos, a shinobi is given a mission of paramount importance: explore a trap-filled castle to free a lone prisoner. Will the shinobi carry out his task with a merciful heart, or put every enemy to the sword?

Take down the enemies in your way, or stick to the shadows and pursue your goals through stealth.

The Wild West  The Wanderer

A tired soul rides into a dying town beset by outlaws – Success, they call it, though none can imagine why. Against a gang of villains, a lone gunslinger stands no chance, but by working together with the locals, one man may yet make a difference…

Lay traps to thin out the Crazy Bunch’s numbers before the big showdown, or take them all on at once!

Present Day  The Strongest

To be the world’s strongest fighter, the best of the best. It’s a dream shared by many, but one young warrior believes he truly has what it takes to claim the title. By making the skills of other masters his own, he intends to prove himself.

Bait your opponents into using their secret techniques so you can learn and wield them in battle.

The Near Future  The Outsider

A rebellious youth lives a hard life, getting into trouble and picking fights. However, his psychokinetic powers eventually lead him to get involved in a dark conspiracy which can only be stopped through the resurrection of an ancient robot king…

Use your powers to uncover secrets, defeat your enemies in battle, and take control of a giant robot.

The Distant Future  The Mechanical Heart

Aboard the transport freighter Cogito Ergo Sum in the vast void of space, a series of incidents put the ship’s crew in jeopardy. As tempers fray, an autonomous support unit recently given life finds itself embroiled in their disputes.

Survive by evading the xeno-biological specimen that stalks the corridors, and discover the truth behind the mysterious events aboard this isolated ship.

The Middle Ages  The Lord of Dark

Long ago, a hero slew the Lord of Dark. Though that hero has long since vanished, the dread archon has risen once more. A new champion must take up arms to cast down the fiend and deliver the princess from evil...

Recruit former heroes to your cause and deliver the Kingdom of Lucrece from a timeless evil.

Tales as old as time

Tailor your adventure in LIVE A LIVE by deciding which order to tackle the game’s stories in. Play through each to completion one after the other, or mix things up further by jumping between them. The choice is yours!

Enjoy the freedom to explore within each time period, as well as turn-based combat that varies from chapter to chapter. Each hero has their own range of attacks to master – use them wisely against enemies while moving on the battlefield to avoid danger and strike when the time is right.

Experience a unique chapter in RPG history!

Originally only released in Japan for the Super Famicom, LIVE A LIVE on Nintendo Switch brings the game to the west for the first time, resurrected with the same stunning HD-2D graphics used in TRIANGLE STRATEGY and OCTOPATH TRAVELER.

Produced by Takashi Tokita (Chrono Trigger, FINAL FANTASY IV), and featuring music remastered under the supervision of Yoko Shimomura (FINAL FANTASY XV, the Kingdom Hearts series), the game is playable in English, French, German, Spanish and Italian with English and Japanese voice acting throughout.

title: Living Legends: Fallen Sky
description: When your botanist brother finds the legendary beans, he asks you to join him to celebrate! But your hopes for a joyous reunion are quickly dashed when you find him missing and a giant attacks! With stolen magical items wracking havoc on the town, can you stop the Sky Kingdom's wrath and save your brother in time? Find out in this spell-binding hidden-object puzzle adventure!

title: Living Legends: The Crystal Tear - CE
Loop Hero
description:
Wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero. Recover and equip powerful loot for each class of hero for their battles and expand the survivors' camp to reinforce each adventure through the loop. Unlock new classes, new cards, perks and devious guardians on your quest to shatter the endless cycle of despair.

Infinite Adventure: Select from unlockable character classes and deck cards before setting out on each expedition along a randomly generated loop path. No expedition is ever the same as the ones before it.

Plan Your Struggle: Strategically place building, terrain, and enemy cards along each loop to create your own dangerous path. Find balance between the cards to increase your chances of survival while recovering valuable loot and resources for your camp.

Loot and Upgrade: Strike down menacing creatures, recover stronger loot to equip on the fly and unlock new perks along the way.

Expand Your Camp: Turn hard-earned resources into campsite upgrades and gain valueable reinforcements with each completed loop along the expedition path.

Save the Lost World: Overcome a series of unholy guardian bosses over a grand saga to save the world and break the time loop of the Lich!

title: Lord of the Rings, The - The Fellowship of the Ring
Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
description:
A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal.

Now you are invited to fall into the same rabbit hole, in a non-linear mystery with an immense amount of handcrafted puzzles, constantly presenting you with new riddles to solve, each leading you closer to deciphering the enigma of Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.

title: Lost Skies
description:
Intraprendi un viaggio ad alta quota alla scoperta dei resti di antiche civilt e dei misteri del loro declino. Solcando cieli pieni di meraviglie e pericoli, sfrutta tecnologie avanzate per superare ogni sfida e spingerti oltre i limiti dell'ingegnosit umana.


Dovrai esplorare antiche rovine e usare Atlas, il misterioso potere che tiene a galla il mondo, per risolvere enigmi e riscoprire la preziosa tecnologia dei popoli del passato. Ma il pericolo si nasconde dietro ogni angolo, sia sulla terraferma che nei cieli. Difenditi dalle torrette e dai droni antichi che ti danno la caccia tra le isole sospese e prendi parte a battaglie epiche contro creature colossali che vagano per i cieli dall'era in cui hanno distrutto l'umanit.


In questo vasto mondo aperto, il tuo viaggio sar definito dall'aeronave che costruirai. Ô pi di una semplice imbarcazione:  al contempo la tua casa e la tua arma. Grazie al sistema di costruzione avanzato di Lost Skies, puoi posizionare le parti liberamente per dar vita a una fortezza volante tanto unica quanto la tua immaginazione. Personalizza la tua aeronave bilanciando robustezza, agilit e potenza di fuoco per affrontare le sfide che incontrerai. Ogni aeronave  unica, quindi lascia che la tua creativit spicchi il volo!


Perch limitarsi a volare, quando puoi planare, dondolarti e arrampicarti tra le nuvole? Scala ripide pareti rocciose o attraversa le isole volanti di Lost Skies utilizzando strumenti basati sulla fisica: un rampino, un deltaplano e una tuta alare che renderanno ogni tuo movimento davvero entusiasmante. Esplora con facilit, muovendoti liberamente verso orizzonti lontani e luoghi mozzafiato. Questo mondo fantastico aspetta solo di essere conquistato, un passo audace alla volta.


Libera la tua immaginazione con l'intuitivo Creatore di isole di Lost Skies. Progetta e costruisci isole personalizzate, poi condividile con la community nel Workshop di Steam. Scarica ed esplora le creazioni di altri giocatori per arricchire ancora di pi la tua avventura. I cieli sono infiniti, proprio come la creativit degli esploratori.

Entra su Discord per unirti all'attiva community di Orizzonti perduti, piena di visionari creativi ed esploratori entusiasti che stanno contribuendo a plasmare il futuro del gioco!
labels: Crafting e sopravvivenza a mondo aperto

title: Lost Vikings, The
description: The GBA port is identical to the SNES version, but the password feature has been removed and replaced with three save slots, no longer allowing the player to replay any level at any time.

title: Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime
description:
Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime is a frantic couch co-op action space shooter for 1-4 players*. Explore a colourful galaxy in a massive neon battleship that you control together by manning turrets, lasers, shields and thrusters. Only through teamwork can you triumph over the evil forces of Anti-Love, rescue kidnapped space-bunnies, and avoid a vacuumy demise.

Local co-op gameplay

2 to 4 players* (or 1 player plus a loyal AI space-pet) need to work together to man the different battle stations, dashing back and forth between weapons, shields and engines. All players fill important roles at all times, and nobody gets left behind.

Upgradable ships

Find and combine powerful space-gems to customise your ship's loadout. Each gem provides different abilities, letting you learn the right tools for every situation.

A new experience every time

Randomised level layouts mean that all players will be exploring fresh areas every time you play.

Simple controls, deep challenge

Controlling your spacenaut is so simple that anyone can jump in quickly, but getting all players to work together like a well-oiled machine, battling a galaxy of evil robots and constellations – that’s the tricky part.

*Multiplayer requires one compatible controller per player. Additional controllers (sold separately) may be required.

title: Luigi's Mansion
description:
Introduzione

Dopo il successo del sequel Dark Moon, Nintendo ha deciso di riportare le origini della saga sulla console portatile con il remake del classico per GameCube. In Luigi's Mansion, l'eterno secondo vestito di verde deve superare le proprie paure per esplorare una villa infestata e salvare suo fratello Mario, catturato da Re Boo. Armato solo di una torcia e del Poltergust 3000, Luigi deve aspirare fantasmi e risolvere enigmi in un'avventura che mescola sapientemente horror leggero e commedia.

L'atmosfera è cupa ma ironica, un omaggio ai film di case stregate in stile Disney. Il tono è intriso di personalità: i tremolii di Luigi, il suo canticchiare per farsi coraggio e le interazioni con il bizzarro Professor Strambic rendono l'esperienza unica e indimenticabile.

Meccaniche di Gioco

Il gameplay ruota attorno alla cattura dei fantasmi: bisogna prima stordirli con la luce della torcia e poi "pescarli" con l'aspirapolvere, contrastando i loro movimenti con lo stick analogico per svuotare i loro punti vita.

Elementi distintivi includono la Caccia ai Fantasmi Ritratto, boss unici con routine specifiche che richiedono ingegno per essere stanati, e l'uso del Game Boy Horror per scansionare l'ambiente in prima persona. Questa versione 3DS introduce inoltre il supporto al C-Stick (su New 3DS) per gestire la direzione dell'aspirapolvere e una modalità Cooperativa Locale dove un secondo giocatore può interpretare "Gommiluigi".

Perché Giocarci

  • Effetto 3D Immersivo: La struttura a "casa di bambole" delle stanze della villa beneficia enormemente della profondità 3D, rendendo l'esplorazione molto più suggestiva dell'originale.
  • Modalità Boss Rush: Una nuova sezione che permette di riaffrontare i fantasmi ritratto per migliorare i propri tempi e punteggi.
  • Mappa sempre visibile: L'uso del secondo schermo per la mappa e l'inventario risolve uno dei piccoli fastidi della versione GameCube, rendendo la navigazione fluida.
  • Design dei Fantasmi: I fantasmi di questo primo capitolo hanno molta più personalità e "storia" rispetto ai nemici generici dei seguiti.

Criticità

  • Controlli su Old 3DS: Senza il secondo stick analogico del New 3DS o l'accessorio Circle Pad Pro, gestire la mira verso l'alto o il basso può risultare scomodo.
  • Risoluzione: Nonostante i modelli siano stati aggiornati, la bassa risoluzione dello schermo del 3DS può far perdere alcuni dettagli delle texture originali.
  • Durata: Rimane un gioco piuttosto breve, completabile in circa 5-6 ore, anche se la ricerca dei Boo e dei tesori aggiunge rigiocabilità.

Note Personali & Consigli

Giocare a Luigi's Mansion con l'effetto 3D attivo è quasi un obbligo: vedere la polvere fluttuare nelle stanze illuminate solo dalla torcia crea un'immersione fantastica. Un consiglio per i cacciatori di tesori: scansionate sempre gli specchi con il Game Boy Horror, spesso fungono da teletrasporto per tornare rapidamente all'atrio della villa. E non dimenticate di annaffiare le piante nel giardino; la pazienza vi premierà con gemme e monete preziose.

Storico

Pubblicato nel 2018 da Nintendo e sviluppato da Grezzo (già famosi per i remake di Zelda), questo titolo è arrivato quasi a fine vita del 3DS. La migliore versione da giocare oggi per fedeltà grafica rimane quella GameCube, ma questa versione 3DS è superiore per funzionalità e profondità visiva. Su emulatore Citra, il gioco è splendido: scalando la risoluzione a 3x e mappando i controlli su un controller Xbox o PlayStation, si ottiene la versione definitiva dell'avventura. È possibile trovare patch per sbloccare il frame-rate a 60 FPS, rendendo la cattura dei fantasmi incredibilmente fluida.

title: LumbearJack
description: Grab your axe and save the environment by chopping and recycling every man-made thing in your path and solving puzzles with your charming animal friends!

title: Machinarium
description:
Aiuta il robot Josef a salvare la sua fidanzata Berta rapita dalla banda delle Capinere!

Machinarium  un premiatissimo gioco indipendente rompicapo/avventura, sviluppato dai creatori dei popolari giochi Samorost e Botanicula.

Un robottino, gettato in un deposito di
rottami in periferia, deve ritornare in citt e
affrontare la Confraternita dei Berretti Neri per
salvare la sua robo-fidanzata.
  • Ambientazione: Machinarium  un
    mondo popolato esclusivamente da
    robot di vario tipo e funzione. Uno dei
    luoghi pi peculiari di questa terra  la
    vecchia, rugginosa e leggendaria metropoli chiamata
    Machinarium, ove si svolge la vicenda
    narrata durante il gioco.
  • Trama: Dovrai sbarazzarti dei malvagi
    robot appartenenti alla Confraternita dei Berretti Neri, salvare il sindaco e pure la
    tua fidanzatina robotica!
  • Enigmi: Dovrai risolvere svariati
    problemi di logica, avventurarti in
    missioni, rompicapo e mini-giochi.
  • Grafica: Gli sfondi e i personaggi
    bidimensionali sono stati disegnati a
    mano e c' pi di un'ora d'animazione
    realizzata con estrema cura.
  • Musica: La meravigliosa originale colonna sonora
     stata composta e registrata da Floex
    (autore di Samorost 2).
  • Interazione: Non ti dovrai sorbire lunghi
    e noiosi dialoghi mentre giochi: i
    personaggi comunicano grazie a semplici
    fumetti animati e simboli.

title: Mages of Mystralia
description:
Nel regno di Mystralia, ci vogliono pi cervello che muscoli per avere successo. Affronterai creature colossali e potentissime, e attraverserai percorsi insidiosi. Dovrai risolvere rompicapo che metterebbero in difficolt anche il pi avveduto dei saggi anziani. E superare gli ostacoli seminati da coloro che sperano nel tuo fallimento.

Il tuo cammino non sar facile. In Mages of Mystralia vesti i panni di Ziya, una giovane ragazza che scopre di avere un'innata propensione per la magia. Purtroppo la magia  stata bandita ormai da tempo, perci, tutta sola, si lancer in un viaggio di addestramento per imparare a controllare i suoi poteri. Lungo la strada incontrer altri maghi esuli e scoprir rune dalle propriet magiche, che imparer a combinare in milioni di modi diversi per creare incantesimi sempre nuovi.

La storia  stata scritta dall'autore di bestseller Ed Greenwood, creatore dell'universo fantasy "Forgotten Realms" di Dungeons and Dragons, fonte d'ispirazione per giochi come "Baldur's Gate" e "Neverwinter Nights", e per almeno 170 libri fantasy.

Caratteristiche principali

  • Crea incantesimi per combattere, risolvere enigmi e sconfiggere boss epici.
  • Sistema di creazione degli incantesimi intuitivo, ma anche dettagliato.
  • Classico gioco d'avventura/azione, con pi di una dozzina di regioni diverse da esplorare.
  • Colonna sonora originale diretta da Shota Nakama ed eseguita dalla Video Game Orchestra al SoundtRec di Boston, famoso anche per le colonne sonore di Final Fantasy XV e Kingdom Hearts.

title: Magic: Legends
description:
A thrilling Action RPG set across the iconic planes of Magic: The Gathering! In Magic: Legends, become immersed in the acclaimed fictional Magic multiverse as a powerful, spell-wielding Planeswalker.

The Magic: Legends servers will cease operation on October 31, 2021, at 11:59pm Pacific.

title: Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse, The
description:
Pluto has disappeared and his pal Mickey is hot on his trail! But evil Emperor Pete won't make it easy. He's snatched poor Pluto and hidden him deep within his dungeon. Now, Mickey must summon his courage and begin a treacherous trek through Emperor Pete's magical world to rescure his chum before it's too late!

Jump and touch the clouds as you and Mickey leap past buzzing bees and sinister snakes in the Treetops. Journey through the Dark Forest and dazzle Pete's guards with the power of Mickey's magical turban! Sink into the blazing inferno of the Fire Grotto and help Firefighter Mickey extinguish the flames! Scale the rocky heights of Pete's Peak and head straight for Emperor Pete's castle. Sneak inside, and Mickey must face the awesome might of Emperor Pete's sinister magic! Hurry! Pluto needs your help!

title: Magician Lord
description:
Magician Lord is a side-scrolling platform game that was a launch title for both the Neo-Geo MVS (arcade) and AES (home) systems, and was one of the pack-in games for the Neo-Geo AES.

The game was re-released through the Virtual Console download service in Europe and Australia on October 26, 2007, and in North America on October 29, 2007. It was later released for the PlayStation 3 and PlayStation Portable through the PlayStation Store. It was previously included in SNK Arcade Classics Vol. 1, released for the Wii, PlayStation 2 and PlayStation Portable in North America on May 1, 2008.

title: Magicka
description:
Magicka  un satirico gioco d'azione e avventura, ambientato in un vasto mondo fantasy basato sulla mitologia nordica. Il giocatore impersona un mago proveniente da un ordine sacro, incaricato di fermare uno stregone malvagio che ha scaraventato il mondo nel caos, soggiogando le forze del bene con le sue terribili creazioni. I giocatori saranno in grado di combinare elementi per lanciare magie, creando scompiglio e distruzione tra i servitori del male. Potranno inoltre collaborare con gli amici per proseguire nella campagna, o testare le loro abilit nelle arti magicke in altre impegnative modalit. In Magicka, un massimo di quattro giocatori pu cimentarsi in una grandiosa avventura per salvare un mondo dal fato ormai certo, sfruttando un sistema di magie completamente dinamico. La modalit avventura porta il giocatore attraverso tre livelli differenti, spaziando dalle rigogliose foreste delle valli di montagna ai corridoi ghiacciati del Re della Montagna, dove astuzia e creativit sono la chiave per la vittoria. Nella modalit sbloccabile "sfida hardcore", i giocatori lottano contro orde di nemici per aggiudicarsi una posizione nelle leaderboard locali e online.

Caratteristiche principali:

  • Sistema d'incantesimi innovativo e dinamico
  • Oltre a potersi cimentare in una modalit per giocatore singolo, sino a quattro giocatori possono collaborare in tutte le modalit di gioco
  • Avventurati in una campagna composta da 13 differenti livelli
  • Esplora un vasto reame di avventure per sconfiggere il malvagio stregone
  • Trova e sblocca sfide, oggetti e potenti Magicke
  • Goditi la satira e la parodia di un mondo fantasy pieno di clich

title: Mail Mole + 'Xpress Deliveries
description: Mail Mole is a charming 3D platformer featuring Molty, the fastest delivery mole, in his quest to save Carrotland from disaster! Explore magical worlds, make new friends, race against Mecha-Moles, find collectibles, solve puzzles and deliver awesomeness to the end of the world!

title: Make Way
description: Speed around loops, dart through train crossings, drift around helter skelters, and unleash wacky weaponry in this modern take on classic top-down multiplayer racing games. The twist? You build the track.

title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
description:
Slay your way in this epic dark fantasy action RPG.

Battle monsters, craft powerful upgrades for your weapons and gear, and explore the secrets of an expansive, interconnected world.

DEFY YOUR FATE

You are an Inquisitor. As evil seeps into Faelduum through tears in reality, defy your purpose and embark on a path that leads to the heart of this world’s unraveling fate. From the towering majesty of Crimson City, through festering darkness, and into the horrors of Entropy... what will you become at journey’s end?

MASTER SOULSLIKE COMBAT

Choose from six unique Classes and wield blades and magic to master your craft in brutal battles. Dodge, parry, and strike with perfect timing to hunt vicious creatures and nightmarish bosses.

SUCCUMB TO A DARK FANTASY WORLD

Fall into a sinister tale featuring multiple endings, written by Brian Mitsoda and hauntingly soundtracked by Christos Antoniou (Septicflesh) and the FILMharmonic Orchestra Prague. 60 quests and 75 unique locations await your discovery across a vast, ruined world.

SLAY YOUR WAY

Create your Inquisitor and develop them through six Talent Trees. Hundreds of skill and combat upgrades are available, and you can also craft powerful weapons and gear to define your playstyle, die less, and deal death faster.

New to action RPG or Soulslike games? Tune the difficulty to your skill level in the settings.

title: Maneater
description: You were cut from your mother's body and left to die in the unforgiving waters of the Gulf Coast. Your only tools are your wits, your jaws, and an uncanny ability to evolve as you feed. Anything and everything is on the menu... provided you kill it before it kills you.

title: Mario & Luigi - Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey
Mario & Luigi - Superstar Saga + Bowser's Minions
Mario & Luigi: Brothership
description:
All hands on deck for an island-hopping adventure!

The brothers return for a new adventure on the high seas! Set sail with Mario and Luigi, exploring islands, enjoying action-packed encounters, and tackling turn-based combat in Mario & Luigi: Brothership on Nintendo Switch.

Somewhere, beyond the horizon

The world of Concordia has broken apart! Originally unified under the mighty Uni-Tree, the land now lies fractured into many different islands, and its inhabitants are separated from each other across vast seas.

Enter Mario and Luigi, the heroes with a brotherly bond! After arriving unexpectedly in Concordia, they set out with new friends – plus some familiar faces – to reconnect the islands, track down the cause of the disaster and save the day.

Two brothers, one adventure

Welcome aboard Shipshape Island – part island, part ship! Guided by currents, you’ll sail across the ocean and encounter lots of different islands to visit. Each is unique, with new faces to meet and places to explore – here are just a few of them!

Rumbla Island

Florall Island

Twistee Island

Merrygo Island

Skorcheen Island

Slippenglide Island

Make your way to each island’s Lighthouse by solving puzzles, battling monsters and helping out the locals, then reconnect it to Shipshape Island to start bringing Concordia back together!

Luigi

Mario

Whether exploring or in the heat of battle, the Mario Bros. always work as a team! Take control of both Mario and Luigi at the same time, using each brother’s dedicated buttons to jump, attack, dodge and more.

Ship ahoy!

The seas of Concordia are full of shipmates and scoundrels alike! Here are just some of the seadogs you’ll encounter on your voyage:

Mario

One half of the famed Mario Bros. (as if you didn’t know!). Whether it’s leaping over obstacles or hammering enemies, he’s here to help Connie restore Concordia to its former glory.

Luigi

The other half of the famed Mario Bros., he’s lean, green and keen to lend a hand. Watch out for his bursts of inspiration – you never know when a bit of Luigi Logic might be useful!

Connie

A young girl who found herself aboard Shipshape Island after Concordia was broken. She's intent on growing a new Uni-Tree to bring everything back together, one island at a time.

Snoutlet

As well as helping Connie on her mission to save Concordia, this flying fellow regularly lends Mario and Luigi a hand…er, hoof. But let’s be clear – he AIN'T a pig!

Zokket and the Extension Corps

A trio of troublemakers – Ecks, Ten and Shun – looking to cause problems for Mario and Luigi, while their mysterious leader schemes in the shadows over the downfall of Concordia.

and more!

Being a whole world away can’t stop some familiar faces appearing – not only does Princess Peach drop in to help the Mario Bros., but Bowser’s also on hand to cause his own brand of trouble!

Shape up and ship out

Guide Shipshape Island around the currents of Concordia’s seas, using the spyglass to watch for islands and other places of interest. If you spot an island on the horizon, use the cannon to blast Mario and Luigi over for a closer look!

Once you’ve landed, it’s time to explore! Every island has a unique environment, and controlling Mario and Luigi as a duo is key to getting around. From see-saws and wall hangs, to puzzles where only working together can clear the way, it’s all about teamwork!

The goal of each island is to reach the Lighthouse and reconnect it to the Uni-Tree. Islands change as your quest continues, so it’s worth paying another visit now and then. Plus, if you find the Great Lighthouse of each sea, you can discover even more islands!

Enemies blocking your way? Then it’s time to fight! Battles are turn-based, as Mario and Luigi fight side-by-side with jumping stomps and hammer strikes. Use well-timed button presses to deal extra damage to opponents, or dodge incoming attacks.

If you like your combat with a little extra oomph, try some Bros. Attacks on for size. These turbo-charged moves require good timing to perform, but seeing Mario and Luigi work together to dish out double-team damage is worth the effort!

Unlock the power of Battle Plugs to add spark to your skills! Depending on which ones you equip, they can boost attacks, beef up defences, provide useful items and more. Each has limited uses before needing a recharge, so choose your moments wisely!

Youve got the moves

When it comes to exploring the islands of Concordia, Bros. Moves are essential! Each one harnesses the connection between Mario and Luigi, and provides unique abilities. You can also upgrade them to become even more powerful!

Looking for more fun with Mario and friends?

Check out the Super Mario hub to see lots more Mario titles!

title: Mario & Sonic at the Rio 2016 Olympic Games
series: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games

title: Mario Tennis Aces
description:
Game, set and super shot!

Settle it on centre court in Mario Tennis Aces for Nintendo Switch, the wildest, most tactical Mario Tennis adventure to date!

In this action-packed sports game, up to four players can ready their rackets and choose from a number of Super Mario series characters, from the main man Mario himself to forgotten favourites like Dry Bones! Whether you’re a newcomer just getting into the swing of things, or a seasoned pro looking for deep strategic payoffs, Mario Tennis Aces serves up a superior game of tennis!

Call the shots

Mario Tennis Aces brings new twists to the good ol’ game of tennis, and offers a refined approach to gameplay. It’s all about non-stop, split-second decisions!

There’s a variety of shots to serve up – topspin, lobs and slices, just to name a few! Watch your opponent’s moves carefully and unleash your most tactical, tricked out shots for game, set and match!

An all-star cast, a star-studded adventure!

All your favourite Mario characters (yes, even Chain Chomp!) are stepping onto the wildest courts yet – in dense jungles, outside bustling train stations, and even aboard seafaring ships!

Wario and Waluigi are in on the action too, and these pesky troublemakers get up to no good in the game’s Adventure mode. When they unearth an ancient tennis racket, they cast a spooky curse on poor Luigi. (As if he wasn’t already enough of a scaredy-cat…)

Now it’s up to Mario to bounce his way through a smashing quest across a colourful world, filled to the brim with the wackiest, wildest and most varied Mario Tennis courts to date! Take on big boss battles, complete missions, contend with all sorts of hazards, and upgrade Mario’s abilities as you go!

Play your way

Whether you’re alone or with friends, get into classic Mario Tennis action in a flash with Free Play. Customise as many – or as few – of the gameplay options as you like!

Getting into the competitive spirit? Best a series of challengers to emerge victorious in a classic knock-out Tournament mode!

Want to take things down a notch? Play a more authentic, stripped down game of tennis where only basic shots are allowed with simple rules, or use your Joy-Con like a tennis racket and play with motion controls in Swing Mode!

Take on the world

With Nintendo Switch, you’re ready to take on challengers anytime, anywhere. Pass a Joy-Con to a friend, connect over local wireless, or hop online for regular tournaments.

title: Mario vs. Donkey Kong - Mini-Land Mayhem!
MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
description:
Tribute Games and Dotemu are teaming up again, in collaboration with Marvel Games, to craft an original, fresh beat 'em up. Featuring dynamic combat combos and dazzling pixel art, this planet-hopping adventure stands as a love letter to the Marvel Universe.

“THE COSMOS MUST FALL SO THAT I MIGHT LIVE!!”

So swears Annihilus, the living death that walks!

After an unprecedented attack is launched across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance.

Nova, Spider-Man, Wolverine, Phyla-Vell, Captain America and many more heroes, both earth-born and cosmic, will join forces in a star-spanning brawling adventure against the deadly Annihilation Wave.

From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Universe will be fought for across the stars in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion!

15 PLAYABLE HEROES

Whether you’re an old-school expert or a first-time fan, you’ll find familiar faces and discover new favorites in a captivating roster of characters from across the Marvel Universe!

MASTER THE COSMIC SWAP TAG-TEAM SYSTEM

With the Cosmic Swap tag-team system, choose two heroes for each level and switch between them instantly. Create unique combos and powerful special attacks. Each character’s abilities encourage creative team-ups and a more tactical approach to the action.

AMAZING RETRO ART DIRECTION

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion is a tribute to one of Marvel’s most iconic eras, with stunning full-color pixel art designs.

INTUITIVE, FUN MULTIPLAYER FOR EVERYONE

Whether you're teaming up with friends or family, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion has you covered with local/online play and a drop-in/drop-out adaptive system.

A cosmic battle awaits!

title: MARVEL SNAP
description:
MARVEL SNAP  il frenetico e pluripremiato gioco di carte collezionabili dalle meccaniche innovative. Lo hanno definito "accessibile e assolutamente geniale" e "uno dei migliori giochi di carte di oggi".

Crea il tuo mazzo di 12 carte. Ogni carta rappresenta un super eroe o un criminale Marvel, ognuno con abilit e poteri unici. L'obiettivo del gioco  superare in astuzia l'avversario. Imparare a giocare  semplice e veloce, e ogni partita dura solo 3 minuti.
Scaricalo ora e scopri perch ne parlano tutti!


Niente pi attese! Ogni partita dura solo tre minuti. Abbiamo eliminato il superfluo per concentrarci solo sulle parti migliori.


Il gioco  costruito per rendere ogni partita unica. Gioca le tue carte su pi di 50 campi diversi dislocati in tutto l'universo Marvel, ognuno caratterizzato da iconiche abilit. Da Asgard al Wakanda, troverai ad attenderti sempre nuovi campi che metteranno alla prova la tua creativit nel formulare strategie di vittoria.


Ogni giocatore inizia con un mazzo gratuito che aiuter a muovere i primi passi. Poi si potranno ottenere nuove carte da aggiungere alla collezione semplicemente giocando e imparando a padroneggiare il gioco. A differenza di altri giochi di carte collezionabili, non ci sono buste da spacchettare su MARVEL SNAP. Pi giocherai pi ricompense otterrai.


Disponibile sia su dispositivi mobili che su PC, gioca dove e quando vuoi! Registra il tuo account per salvare i progressi su tutte le piattaforme.


Lo "SNAP"  una meccanica speciale che ti permette di alzare la posta in gioco durante una partita e di fare pressione sull'avversario. Per esempio, se credi di avere una mano vincente, puoi fare "SNAP" per avere una probabilit di raddoppiare le tue ricompense. E funziona anche se stai bluffando!


Ogni carta del mazzo rappresenta un personaggio unico del Multiverso Marvel. Nessun altro gioco ti permette di collezionare, unire e schierare sul campo tantissime Varianti di tutti gli eroi e criminali dell'universo MARVEL (e oltre)! Non c' dubbio, la carta di Iron Man ispirata ai fumetti classici  stupenda, ma hai visto le varianti chibi, 8-bit e cartone animato?


Io sono Groot. IO SONO Groot. Io sono GROOT. Io sono Groot? Io sono Groot. IO SONO GROOT! Io sono GROOT. Io sono Groot?


MARVEL SNAP rimane sempre emozionante grazie a tanti nuovi contenuti aggiunti regolarmente: carte, campi, cosmetici, Pass stagionali, stagioni classificate, sfide, missioni, eventi e molto altro ancora. Non devi aspettare mesi per gli aggiornamenti!


Ci vuole poco per imparare e solo 3 minuti per giocare. Vieni subito a scoprire perch MARVEL SNAP ha vinto cos tanti premi!

title: Marvel Super Hero Squad - The Infinity Gauntlet
MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics
description:
The legendary crossover hits are back!

Jump into this collection of arcade classics from the fan-favorite Marvel and Capcom crossover games!

Dive into an action-packed lineup consisting of seven unique titles, including heavy hitters like X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER, and MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes. The collection also includes the rare beat 'em up game, THE PUNISHER.

Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op!

Whether you're new to the series or you played back in the arcades, players of all levels can enjoy these timeless classics together!

Smooth Online Play!

Compete in heated ranked battles or play for fun in casual matches. Create a lobby with friends and battle head-to-head, play co-op, or spectate other matches.

However you choose to play, rollback netcode makes the experience smooth and fun!

A High Score Challenge mode is also available. Aim for the top of the global leaderboards!

No Experience? No Problem!

This collection boasts a number of beginner-friendly features such as adjustable difficulty levels, One Button Specials, and training modes.

Plus, players can save and load their progress almost anywhere and pick up right where they left off.

Additional Features!

Players can view more than 500 pieces of artwork from all 7 titles along with never-before-seen development documents used to make the original games.

The Music feature contains over 200 tracks from the original arcade games that players can listen to at any time!

Included Games

X-MEN CHILDREN OF THE ATOM

MARVEL SUPER HEROES

X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER

MARVEL SUPER HEROES vs. STREET FIGHTER

MARVEL vs. CAPCOM CLASH OF SUPER HEROES

MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes

THE PUNISHER

title: MARVEL VS. CAPCOM: INFINITE
description: Lo scontro epico tra due universi leggendari ritorna con Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite, la nuova era dell'amatissima serie di azione e combattimento. Lo scontro tra gli universi di Marvel e Capcom diventa pi intenso che mai quando i personaggi iconici si uniscono per un combattimento player-versus-player ricco di azione. Ultron Sigma ha iniziato l'estirpazione sistematica di tutta la vita biologica. Contro ogni previsione, gli eroi si rialzano dalla polvere per creare nuove alleanze e opporsi insieme alla minaccia definitiva, riponendo tutte le speranze nella potentissima Gemma dell'Infinito.

title: Marvel's Avengers Definitive Edition
description:
Marvel?s Avengers is an action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and published by Square Enix in 2020. It features both a single-player campaign and multiplayer missions, combining narrative-driven gameplay with cooperative online play. The story follows Kamala Khan as she reunites the Avengers after a catastrophic event. Players can control multiple heroes, each with unique abilities and skill trees.

The Definitive Edition includes all released DLC missions and heroes.

title: Marvel's Midnight Suns
description:
Marvel's Midnight Suns  l'evento crossover definitivo, che unisce la storia intricata, le relazioni tra i personaggi, la personalizzazione e la progressione di un GDR con la strategia tattica e le meccaniche da combattimento di un nuovo rivoluzionario gioco di strategia basato sulle carte. All'interno del lato pi oscuro dell'Universo Marvel potrai creare legami indivisibili con i leggendari supereroi Marvel e i pericolosi guerrieri sovrannaturali, nella lotta contro la minaccia pi pericolosa che il mondo abbia mai affrontato: le forze demoniache di Lilith e l'anziano dio Chthon.

La tua avventura Marvel

Tu sei Hunter, il primo eroe originale e completamente personalizzabile dell'universo Marvel. Personalizza il tuo aspetto, scegli le tue reazioni alle situazioni e crea amicizie con leggende Marvel come gli Avengers, X-Men, Runaways e altri. Decidi chi verr con te nelle missioni, quali missioni affrontare e molte altre opzioni che renderanno unica questa esperienza.

Combatti e pensa da supereroe

Dai creatori della serie XCOM acclamata dalla critica arriva un avvincente sistema di combattimento basato sulle carte che premia l'astuzia e lo stile da supereroe. Schiera una squadra di supereroi nelle missioni tattiche a turni per sconfiggere le forze del male. Usa il tuo ambiente, muoviti sul campo di battaglia usando il colpo o la combinazione perfetti e lancia abilit eroe devastanti per essere in vantaggio in ogni incontro. Il combattimento considera i migliori elementi di giochi tattici e combattimenti, per un'esperienza veramente unica.

Vivi con le leggende

Scopri cosa fanno i supereroi nel loro tempo libero. Esplora l'Abbazia, la tua mistica base segreta, per scoprire potenti oggetti nascosti e segreti che ti aiuteranno nella lotta contro Lilith e i suoi scagnozzi. Fai amicizia e impara a conoscere alcuni dei tuoi eroi Marvel preferiti, interagendo con loro in modi che vanno oltre i fumetti o i film.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
description: The latest adventure in the Spider-Man universe will build on and expand Marvels Spider-Man through an all-new story. Players will experience the rise of Miles Morales as he masters new powers to become his own Spider-Man.

title: Mary Skelter Finale
description:
The last installment of the dungeon-crawling RPG trilogy reaches its stunning conclusion! Will the Blood Maidens finally get their happily ever after?

Jail - a living prison for humans, buried 666 meters underground. It appeared suddenly several decades ago, giving birth to monsters called Marchen and patrolled by madness-inducing Nightmares.

A group of prisoners, Jack and the Blood Maidens, were reincarnations of fairy tales who dared to escape. They climbed from the bottom of the tower up to the surface, filled with hope...

But outside were thousands of corpses soaking in a sea of blood. There stood beings known as Massacre Pink, smiling. In that moment, hope was destroyed. The group was torn asunder, with Jack and the Blood Maidens scattered to their own paths.

Separated, they are each drawn to the devouring Jail that floats in the sky...

This is the finale to the tale of the Blood Maidens.

title: Masterplan Tycoon
description: Masterplan Tycoon is a real-time strategy game about building interconnected chains of resources in a minimalist visual style. The nodes are buildings. The pins are contact points between them. The links are supply lines. Create the largest logistics system possible.

title: MediEvil: Resurrection
description:
Introduzione

MediEvil: Resurrection è il reimagining del classico per PlayStation del 1998, lanciato come titolo di punta per il debutto di PSP. Il gioco segue le gesta (e i fallimenti) di Sir Daniel Fortesque, un cavaliere codardo resuscitato per errore dal malvagio mago Zarok. Nonostante Daniel sia morto nella prima carica della battaglia di Gallowmere, il destino gli offre una seconda occasione per diventare l'eroe che non è mai stato. L'atmosfera fonde sapientemente il macabro con lo stile slapstick, creando un'esperienza visivamente ispirata ai mondi di Tim Burton.

Meccaniche di Gioco

Il gameplay è un action-adventure che alterna combattimenti all'arma bianca, esplorazione e risoluzione di semplici enigmi ambientali. Il core loop prevede l'attraversamento di livelli lineari in cui Dan deve sconfiggere orde di non-morti per riempire il Calice delle Anime: una volta completato, il calice permette l'accesso al Salone degli Eroi, dove Dan può ottenere armi leggendarie dai suoi ex compagni d'armi. Rispetto all'originale, questa versione introduce mini-giochi inediti e un sistema di combattimento leggermente rivisto, mantenendo però la gestione delle armi a distanza e degli scudi deteriorabili.

Perché Giocarci

  • Personalità e Humor: Il carisma di Sir Dan e i dialoghi ironici rendono l'avventura leggera e divertente, nonostante l'ambientazione cimiteriale.
  • Design dei Livelli: Ogni stage è visivamente distintivo e traboccante di segreti, offrendo un'ottima varietà di situazioni tra labirinti, villaggi stregati e navi fantasma.
  • Comparto Audio: Il doppiaggio italiano è eccellente e la colonna sonora orchestrale cattura perfettamente l'essenza gotica e fiabesca del titolo.

Criticità

  • Gestione della Telecamera: A causa dell'assenza di un secondo stick analogico sulla PSP, la visuale deve essere riposizionata manualmente con i tasti dorsali, risultando spesso problematica durante i combattimenti più concitati o le sezioni platform.

Note Personali & Consigli

Non dimenticate di parlare spesso con l'Al-Zalam, il piccolo genio che vive nel cranio di Dan: i suoi commenti sarcastici sono tra i momenti più divertenti del gioco. Un suggerimento pratico: usate con parsimonia le armi a distanza (come i pugnali da lancio) contro i nemici base; conservatele per i boss o per i nemici volanti che sono difficili da colpire con la spada.

Storico

Questo titolo è una rivisitazione del primo capitolo della saga, nata su PS1 e proseguita con MediEvil 2. Specifiche sulle versioni: Rilasciato originariamente su PSP (2005), è stato successivamente reso disponibile sul PlayStation Store per PS Vita e più recentemente su PS4 e PS5 tramite il servizio PlayStation Plus Premium. La scelta migliore oggi: Sebbene la versione emulata ufficialmente su PS5 offra trofei e funzioni di riavvolgimento, l'esperienza definitiva si ottiene emulando la versione PSP originale tramite PPSSPP su PC. Questo permette di forzare la risoluzione in 4K, eliminando completamente l'aliasing dell'epoca, e di mappare la telecamera sullo stick destro del controller moderno, risolvendo di fatto il più grande limite tecnico del gioco originale.

title: Mega Man Legacy Collection
description:
Mega Man Legacy Collection is a celebration of the 8-bit history of Capcom’s iconic Blue Bomber. Featuring faithful reproductions of the series’ origins with the original six Mega Man games, the Legacy Collection will remind long-time fans and introduce newcomers to what made Mega Man such a popular and iconic character.

  • Includes the six 8-bit classics that originally released on the Nintendo Entertainment System (Mega Man, Mega Man 2, Mega Man 3, Mega Man 4, Mega Man 5, and Mega Man 6)
  • Explore the series’ history with rare concept art and original promotional materials in Museum Mode
  • Tackle stage remixes in Challenge Mode and compete against your friends for the fastest completion times on the online leaderboards*
  • Unlock additional trials in Challenge Mode using the Mega Man amiibo!
  • A handy new Rewind feature gives players the option to instantly reverse gameplay, correcting unexpected pitfalls or deadly enemy encounters
  • The new Turbo CPU Speed feature also lets players take advantage of the performance power of the Nintendo Switch to reduce slowdown when the action gets intense
  • The magic of the Nintendo Switch allows you to play Mega Man at home or on the go!

*Internet connection required during online play. To use online services, you must create a Nintendo Account and accept the related agreement. The Nintendo Account Privacy Policy applies. Some online services may not be available in all countries. Starting September 2018, some online services will also require a paid subscription. Paid online service availability may be limited based on location. Find out more about the paid membership service.

title: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1
description:
The origin of stealth action returns. METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol. 1 unifies the beginning of the METAL GEAR gameplay experience in one single package. Infiltrate enemy fortresses all over the globe, complete your missions with stealth and experience the thrilling cinematic story of the METAL GEAR series.

Volume 1 line-up features the original titles and beginning of the METAL GEAR series, including the original versions of Metal Gear and Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake, Metal Gear Solid (which also includes VR Missions/Special Missions), and the HD Collection versions of Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty and Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Each main title in the line-up will also include an exclusive digital Screenplay Book and Master Book that details the story and characters in that game. This collection includes the classic versions of the games, complete with only minimal edits to copyrighted contents.

Those who purchase Volume 1 will also have access to a variety of bonus content including the two regional versions of Metal Gear, the original version of Snake's Revenge, the first and second Digital Graphic Novels in video form, and a digital soundtrack.

[Title lineup]

  • Metal Gear
  • Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake
  • Metal Gear Solid (Including VR Missions/Special Missions)
  • Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (HD Collection version)
  • Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (HD Collection version)
  • Metal Gear (NES/FC version)
  • Snake's Revenge

Regional versions of the titles are available as additional downloads.

[Video]

  • Metal Gear Solid: Digital Graphic Novel
  • Metal Gear Solid 2: Digital Graphic Novel

[Digital book]

  • Metal Gear Solid: Screenplay Book
  • Metal Gear Solid: Master Book
  • Metal Gear Solid 2: Screenplay Book
  • Metal Gear Solid 2: Master Book
  • Metal Gear Solid 3: Screenplay Book
  • Metal Gear Solid 3: Master Book
  • Metal Gear & Metal Gear 2: Screenplay Book
  • Metal Gear & Metal Gear 2: Master Book

The digital books can be accessed from the game's main menu screen.

[Soundtrack]

Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack

title: METAL SLUG
description:
?METAL SLUG ?, il primo titolo della leggendaria serie di giochi di sparatorie 2D della SNK, il gioco da cui tutto ha avuto inizio, ritorna su Steam!

CARATTERISTICHE PRINCIPALI

Gioca alla versione arcade originale di ?METAL SLUG ? con i suoi carismatici protagonisti Marco & Tarma, controlla il potente carro armato ?METAL SLUG ? e combatti nelle 6 missioni del gioco per fermare le malvagie ambizioni del Generale Morden!

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
description:
Dalle menti creative dietro Persona 3, 4 e 5 arriva Metaphor: ReFantazio.

Preparati alla nuova evoluzione del JRPG fantasy con Metaphor: ReFantazio, disponibile ora. Vincitore di oltre 50 premi, con una demo gratuita che trasferisce i salvataggi nel gioco completo. Partecipa al Torneo del Trono per lottare per la corona e il futuro. Controlla il tuo destino, affronta le tue paure e risveglia i magici poteri degli "archetipi" che giacciono sopiti nel tuo cuore. Fai squadra con personaggi interessanti e intraprendi un viaggio immersivo che promette ore di esplorazione coinvolgente, una miscela dinamica di combattimento a turni e azione in tempo reale, e scoperte entusiasmanti.

Caratteristiche principali:

-Il pi recente JRPG fantasy di ATLUS: Una storia misteriosa e dinamica si svolge in un mondo in cui la gente deve combattere le proprie ansie. Partecipa all'ambito Torneo del Trono che promette ore di esplorazione e scoperte coinvolgenti.

-Direzione artistica pluripremiata: Viaggia sul tuo trasvettore verso dungeon e citt distanti attraversando un mondo enorme. Scopri paesaggi meravigliosi accompagnati da musiche avvincenti, un'interfaccia immersiva e filmati in stile anime.

-Sistema di combattimento innovative: Un'appassionante miscela di combattimento a turni e azione in tempo reale. Personalizzando il gruppo con i poteri degli "archetipi", farai tua l'avventura.

-Sistema di gestione del tempo: Svolgi missioni, esplora dungeon e caccia tesori di giorno. Rafforza i rapporti, instaura legami e aumenta le virt di sera. Scegli bene cosa fare: gestire il tempo sar cruciale per il tuo obiettivo.

title: Metroid Dread
description:
Try it for free!

An updated version of the free demo of Metroid Dread is now available. Descend into the depths of planet ZDR in either Normal or Rookie Mode and get a taste of Samus Aran's latest mission, culminating in a battle against the huge beast Corpius!

You can download it from Nintendo eShop on your Nintendo Switch console, or via our website – just press the 'Download demo' button to get started!

Download demo

New difficulty and Boss Rush modes have arrived in a free update, available now!

Find out more

The hunter becomes the hunted...

On a remote alien planet, a mechanical menace awaits that will push even the galaxy’s greatest bounty hunter to her limit. Join Samus Aran on her deadliest 2D adventure yet in Metroid Dread on Nintendo Switch.

A feeling of imminent dread

The X parasite, a dangerous entity capable of mimicking any living thing, has been wiped out by renowned bounty hunter Samus Aran.

Not long after, however, the Galactic Federation receives a mysterious and distressing transmission: contrary to reports, the X parasite is still alive.

Intent on uncovering the truth, the Federation dispatches a group of Extraplanetary Multiform Mobile Identifier robots – or E.M.M.I. – to planet ZDR, the source of the transmission.

Upon arrival to planet ZDR, contact is lost and the E.M.M.I. disappears without a trace.

Sent to ZDR to investigate, Samus Aran is now the Federation’s only hope to find the E.M.M.I. and determine whether the X parasite is still a threat to the entire galaxy...

The long road ahead

To complete Samus’ mission, navigate your way through the depths of a sprawling planet full of unique environments, perilous danger and mysterious secrets. Use new and familiar abilities to traverse these labyrinths, consult the map to find your way and dispatch hostile enemies in your path using powerful weapons.

As you freely explore the planet, you’ll encounter locked doors, ledges out of reach and areas too hazardous for Samus to safely venture into. By acquiring power-ups and upgrades, you’ll not only overcome these obstacles, but also discover new paths and shortcuts through the environment.

Between revisiting regions to explore previously-inaccessible areas and fighting the many larger monsters ZDR is home to, getting off the planet won’t be easy. Especially since the missing E.M.M.I. are far more dangerous than anyone could have ever imagined…

Armed and dangerous

Samus always has her trusty Arm Cannon to hand but as she explores planet ZDR, she’ll discover additional weapons and abilities that’ll help her uncover the truth about her mission.

Beam

Samus’ primary attack, launching a powerful beam of energy to both vaporise foes and open doors. It can be upgraded to add more power, as well as wider and special shot types.

Grapple Beam

A special upgrade for Samus’ Arm Cannon, allowing her to attach to and swing from special points. Use it to reach previously inaccessible areas.

Melee Counter

Time a Melee Counter perfectly to repel enemy attacks and leave them open for one of your own, even while running or jumping.

Missiles

Powerful explosives that causes great damage to enemies, but can also open up hidden paths. Ammo is limited, but collecting Missile Tanks will expand the quantity Samus can carry.

Morph Ball

Samus can curl her Power Suit up into a ball, allowing her to fit through small gaps and tunnels. She can also drop bombs which allow her to access new areas.

Spider Magnet

Special walls marked in blue can be traversed once Samus has the Spider Magnet, giving her access to new areas of the planet.

Phantom Cloak

When activated, this ability allows Samus to remain hidden from threats, but be warned – the special Aeion energy that powers it drains faster if Samus moves while using it.

The threat of the E.M.M.I.

Tireless, relentless, merciless. Corrupted by unknown forces and no longer controlled by the Federation, the E.M.M.I. robots that stalk the depths of planet ZDR have only one goal: eliminate Samus Aran.

Lurking within designated E.M.M.I. Zones around the planet, these deadly machines are always on the hunt. Explore areas where E.M.M.I. are active carefully to avoid detection – if you’re spotted, the chances of survival are slim so get ready to run!

Samus’ speed, agility and new Phantom Cloak can keep her one step ahead of the E.M.M.I., but it’ll take something more powerful to stop them for good.

Deep within each E.M.M.I. Zone lies the means to temporarily enable the Omega Cannon – the only weapon capable of destroying an E.M.M.I. robot. Keep a steady hand and a steadier nerve while using it though or you’ll never live to fight another day...

Tailor your Metroid Dread experience

Take on the mission your way with additional difficulty modes*! On top of the Normal and unlockable Hard difficulty modes, you can challenge yourself with Dread Mode** where just a single hit means the end of the road for Samus. Alternatively, ease yourself into the exploration of planet ZDR with Rookie Mode, where several adjustments have been made, including reduced damage from bosses and recovery items providing more Energy and Missile ammo than usual.

You can also face off against the toughest battles from Samus' mission one after another in Boss Rush mode*. Complete the game on any difficulty to unlock Boss Rush, or complete Dread Mode and give yourself the ultimate challenge with the ultra-tough Dread Rush!

Compatible with amiibo

New amiibo featuring Samus Aran in her Power Suit from Metroid Dread and an E.M.M.I. robot (available as a two-pack, sold separately) can be used in-game for the following effects:

  • You can tap the Samus amiibo to unlock a bonus permanent Energy Tank, and also use it to recover Energy once per day.
  • You can tap the E.M.M.I. amiibo to unlock a bonus permanent Missile+ Tank, and also use it to recharge Missile ammo once per day.

See all compatible amiibo

Useful intel from the Metroid universe

Packed with information about Samus’ latest mission and featuring insight from the development team, the Metroid Dread Reports are your deep dive into the Metroid saga!

Check them out

*Software update required. Broadband internet connection required to download software updates. The registration and linkage of a Nintendo Account and acceptance of the Nintendo Account Agreement is required.The Nintendo Account Privacy Policy applies.

**Dread Mode is unlocked upon completion of Hard Mode.

title: Metroid Prime Remastered
description:
 STEP BACK INTO THE SUIT 

Become the bounty hunter Samus Aran once again in Metroid Prime Remastered! The critically-acclaimed, first-person adventure has been revamped for Nintendo Switch.

THE CLASSIC ADVENTURE, REBORN

Calm and capable, Samus takes on this solo mission…but she is far from alone.

Step into her boots as you navigate the winding paths and interconnected environments of an alluring-yet-dangerous alien planet. Use powers like the signature Morph Ball and Grapple Beam to access hard-to-reach areas and find a path forward.

Step into her boots as you navigate the winding paths and interconnected environments of an alluring-yet-dangerous alien planet. Use powers like the signature Morph Ball and Grapple Beam to access hard-to-reach areas and find a path forward.

With revamped graphics, sound, unlockable art, and updated control schemes, Samus’ 3D debut has reached even greater heights. Use new dual-stick controls, intuitive motion aiming, revert to classic controls, or opt for a hybrid option – whichever you prefer.

EXPLORE THE ALIEN ENVIRONMENTS AND EERIE ISOLATION OF TALLON IV

Journey through diverse biomes as you uncover the Space Pirates’ sinister experiments and gather information about the toxic substance that left the planet in ruin.

Journey through diverse biomes as you uncover the Space Pirates’ sinister experiments and gather information about the toxic substance that left the planet in ruin.

From the quiet stillness of the snowy Phendrana Drifts to the magma geysers of Magmoor Caverns, this alien planet introduces beautifully harsh landscapes and labyrinths.

Forge ahead to your next objective or take time to stop and scan your surroundings, delving into the secrets held by the creatures and history of Tallon IV.

UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL TO TAKE ON
EXTRA-TERRESTRIAL TERRORS

Use Samus’ Arm Cannon and go head-to-head against otherworldly creatures, bolstered Space Pirates, and the energy-sapping Metroids.

Revisit previously inaccessible areas and pay close attention to your environment to solve puzzles and get more upgrades.

You’ll need the help of abilities like the Ice Beam, Missiles, and several visors to dispatch the alien threats lurking around every corner.

title: Mewgenics
description:
Il roguelite definitivo di tattica a turni e allevamento di gatti

Il nuovo roguelite legacy profondamente tattico di Edmund McMillen (The Binding of Isaac, Super Meat Boy) e Tyler Glaiel (Closure, The End Is Nigh) ti pone la seguente domanda:

E se potessi allevare un esercito perfetto di guerrieri felini e poi mandarli ad affrontare avventure tattiche alla ricerca di cibo, denaro e una montagna di tesori?

Il ciclo dei gatti:

Ti diamo il benvenuto nella Contea di Boon: ogni giorno assemblerai una squadra scegliendo tra i gatti della tua casa in continua evoluzione, e li equipaggerai con dei collari specifici per classe (Guerriero, Corazzato, Mago e molte altre). Manda la tua squadra di felini mutanti a farsi strada in avventure costellate di battaglie a turni che richiedono un posizionamento oculato, combo esplosive di poteri e bravate ambientali di ogni tipo.

Combattimenti che premiano la maestria:

Con oltre 1000 abilità uniche (75 per classe), più di 900 oggetti e innumerevoli interazioni ambientali, ogni partita ti propone nuovi rompicapi tattici. È un gioco estremamente profondo e lo spazio per sperimentare e ottimizzare è praticamente infinito.

Alleva il tuo futuro:

I gatti che tornano a casa si portano dietro cicatrici ed esperienza (e, a volte, persino teste aggiuntive!). Trasmetti le loro abilità e mutazioni bizzarre, lavora sul retaggio del tuo esercito, gestisci stranezze genetiche e crea gatti sempre più insoliti e potenti per lavventura successiva.

Un'avventura epica:

  • Campagna principale da oltre 200 ore

  • Oltre 10 classi tra cui scegliere con 75 abilità uniche ciascuna

  • Oltre 900 oggetti folli

  • Più di 200 tra nemici e boss

  • Progressione roguelite: non vivrai mai la stessa partita due volte.

  • Tante scelte da compiere: Soldi! Oggetti!! E geni!!! Tutto conta.

Da semplice a infinitamente complesso:

Mewgenics ti accoglie dolcemente, poi col tempo rivela sempre più livelli di profondità. Le prime partite ti insegneranno le basi, ma presto inizierai a ottimizzare le catene di allevamento, a scoprire combinazioni inaspettate di abilità e a fare scelte strategiche terribili, come decidere di tenere un gattino adorabile per te oppure darlo a uno dei tanti PNG per potenziare la tua casa. Mewgenics ti sfida a raggiungere l'eccellenza nella tattica, abbracciando al contempo un gameplay sempre più caotico.

Costruisci, sperimenta, adatta! C'è sempre un nuovo modo per sperimentare (e distruggere) il gioco.

Ah: puoi accarezzare i gatti.

title: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
description: Microsoft Solitaire Collection is a video game included with Windows 10. It replaces Solitaire, FreeCell and Spider Solitaire included with the previous versions of Windows. It also adds Pyramid and TriPeaks to Windows for the first time and introduces new daily challenges and themes.

title: Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor
description:
Attenzione: dal 31 dicembre 2020 alcune funzionalit de La Terra di Mezzo: L'Ombra di Mordor non saranno pi disponibili.

Funzionalit non pi disponibili:
? la Forgia Nemesi non sar pi disponibile. I giocatori non potranno pi trasferire le loro Nemesi da La Terra di Mezzo: L'Ombra di Mordor a La Terra di Mezzo: L'Ombra della Guerra.
? Le missioni di Faida e le classifiche non saranno pi disponibili.

Vincitore di oltre 50 premi "Best of 2014", tra cui Gioco dell'anno, Miglior gioco d'azione e Videogioco pi innovativo.

title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War
description:
Go behind enemy lines to forge your army, conquer Fortresses and dominate Mordor from within. Experience how the award winning Nemesis System creates unique personal stories with every enemy and follower, and confront the full power of the Dark Lord Sauron and his Ringwraiths in this epic new story of Middle-earth.

In Middle-earth?: Shadow of War?, nothing will be forgotten.

Please note that the multiplayer mode is not supported.

title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes
description:
Might & Magic Clash of Heroes takes place 40 years before the Heroes V saga. Scattered across five different regions of Ashan, five special heroes must travel their own dangerous paths to grow in strength, unravel a demonic plot, and ultimately save the world from Chaos.

Key Features:

  • Master unique and dynamic combat mechanics
    • Art of tactics: Create offensive or defensive unit formations, learn advanced combos and make the best of your spells and artifacts to build up the right strategy and overcome your enemies.
    • Various challenges: Defeat the enemy heroes by crossing their armies in standard battles. Launch into special challenges and Boss fights where your strategic skills will be put to a severe test. Solve puzzle battles by finding the right combination and wipe out the enemy in a limited number of turns.
    • Unit management: Earn & hire units with different attributes and abilities to create your ultimate army combination.
    • Heroes rising: Become more powerful after each battle by earning XP points and level- up your hero and your units.
    • HD art, music & sounds: Enjoy the rich Might & Magic universe.
  • Experience an Epic Adventure:
    • Vibrantly detailed settings: Explore highly detailed maps full of knights, elves, wizards, necromancers, and demons and interact with a unique manga-style inspired environment.
    • Prequel to Might & Magic© Heroes©: Play the childhood of the five main Heroes: Anwen, Godric, Fiona, Aidan and Nadia.
    • Traverse the fantasy world of Ashan: Recruit & level up units, and discover hidden artifacts to build the most powerful army.
  • Hot seat 1v1 and Online 2 to 4 Players PVP & Coop Mode on Steam?
    • Multiple Heroes: Choose from 10 different characters, each one featuring unique spells and abilities.
    • Build your own army: Select the best combination of creatures and artifacts to give you the strongest advantage on the battlefield.
    • Join a friend and face up to two opponents in dynamic and strategic co-op battles.

title: Minecraft Dungeons
description:
AN EPIC ADVENTURE

Unite. Fight. Survive.

Fight your way through an all-new action adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

AN EPIC ADVENTURE

Unite. Fight. Survive.

Fight your way through an all-new action adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

ARE YOU READY TO FACE THE ARCH-ILLAGER?

Unite

Brave the dungeons alone, or team up with friends! Up to four players can battle together in local* and online** co-op.

Fight

Use melee swings, hang back with ranged attacks, or tank your way through shielded by heavy armour! Personalise your character and unlock unique items and weapon enchantments for devastating special attacks.

Survive

Explore action-packed, treasure-stuffed, wildly varied levels – all in an epic quest to save the villagers and take down the evil Arch-Illager!

Cross-Play

Take on the Arch Illager with friends across all platforms – thanks to cross-platform play in Minecraft Dungeons, you can unite, fight and survive together!

Dungeons Add-Ons

Discover even more Minecraft Dungeons action! Additional content is sold separately. Minecraft Dungeons: Hero Edition (digital/physical) and the Hero Pass Upgrade include some additional content, listed in their descriptions.***

Hero Pass

Already have Minecraft Dungeons but are looking for a bit more? Upgrade your Minecraft Dungeons experience with the Hero Pass! The Hero Pass includes a Hero Cape, two player skins, a Chicken Pet, and the first two DLC packs (Jungle Awakens and Creeping Winter) as soon as they become available.

Season Pass

Continue the story and uncover the secrets of Minecraft Dungeons! With the Season Pass, you'll have access to four new DLC packs – Howling Peaks, Flames of the Nether, Hidden Depths and Echoing Void. Take on new mobs, navigate new levels, collect unique items and discover brand-new missions.

See all DLC

*Local multiplayer requires one compatible controller per player. Additional controllers (sold separately) may be required.

**Internet connection required during online play. To use online services, you must create a Nintendo Account and accept the related agreement. The Nintendo Account Privacy Policy applies. Some online services may not be available in all countries. Online play requires paid online membership. Find out more about the paid membership subscription.

***To download this content, additional storage may be needed. If you dont have enough system storage in the Nintendo Switch console, please use a compatible microSD card. Please visit our Support section for more information about compatible microSD card.

title: MISTOVER
description: ''MIST-ical' RPG with expeditions for finding the key to survival. Choose your next step wisely and keep in mind that your every move will change the future.

title: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
description:
Enjoy a colorful action-adventure game made alongside Ryuichi Nishizawa, creator of the original Wonder Boy in Monster World series.

Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom borrows the best from the classic series to deliver a fresh, modern adventure with fun gameplay, memorable music and gorgeous hand drawn animations.

Can Jin save Monster World Kingdom? Help our young hero defeat challenging enemies, discover hidden locations, upgrade powerful equipment, and more! You'll also unlock special forms with unique skills used to open new paths where mighty bosses and secret treasures await.

Feature Overview:

- Six awesome forms with unique combat and platforming abilities to make your adventure exciting from start to finish.

- Unlock new paths and secrets with special equipment: look for magic weapons and items that gradually open up the world.

- Over 15 hours of epic adventure: explore the new Monster World in a vast interconnected environment.

- Hand Drawn animations: characters and enemies come to life with detailed animations and fun facial expressions.

- Soundtrack from iconic Japanese composers: Yuzo Koshiro, Motoi Sakuraba, Michiru Yamane, Keiki Kobayashi and Takeshi Yanagawa.

- Full HD graphics at 60 fps: the game supports 1080p/60fps in TV mode and 720p/60fps in Nintendo Switch handheld mode.

- HD rumble support: feel the action with high performance HD rumble support.

title: Monster Hunter Rise
description:
Accetta la sfida e unisciti alla caccia! In Monster Hunter Rise, l'ultimo capitolo della serie pi venduta e pluripremiata Monster Hunter, entrerai a far parte dei cacciatori, esplorerai mappe nuove di zecca e utilizzerai tantissime armi per abbattere temibili mostri all'interno di una trama nuovissima. La versione per PC include anche una serie di ulteriori migliorie alle prestazioni e ottimizzazioni grafiche.


Mostri feroci con caratteristiche uniche
Dai la caccia a una miriade di mostri brutali con caratteristiche uniche. Dai mostri pi classici a creature nuovissime ispirate al folklore giapponese (come Magnamalo), dovrai pensare rapidamente e padroneggiare le loro abilit speciali per ottenere ricompense!


Scegli la tua arma e mostra le tue abilit
Impugna 14 diversi tipi di armi che offrono stili di gioco unici, sia da vicino che a distanza. Carica e colpisci duramente con il devastante spadone, sbarazzati dei mostri con stile usando l'elegante spada lunga, diventa un micidiale vortice di lame con le veloci Doppie lame, effettua degli attacchi in carica con la lancia punitiva o prendi la mira a distanza con arco e balestre. Queste sono solo alcune delle tipologie di armi disponibili nel gioco: trovare lo stile di gioco pi adatto a te non sar un problema.


Caccia, raccogli e crea per raggiungere la vetta della catena alimentare
Ogni mostro cacciato ti fornir materiali utili per creare nuove armi e armature e potenziare il tuo equipaggiamento. Rimettiti all'opera e caccia mostri ancora pi feroci per ottenere ricompense persino migliori! Puoi cambiare la tua arma in qualsiasi momento con le casse equipaggiamento: le possibilit sono illimitate!


Caccia in solitaria o fai squadra per abbattere i mostri
La Base di caccia offre missioni in modalit multigiocatore in cui possono allearsi fino a quattro giocatori per affrontare assieme le missioni. Il bilanciamento della difficolt assicura che, sia in solitaria che in squadre da quattro persone, la sfida sia sempre equa.


Grafica mozzafiato, framerate sbloccato e altre ottimizzazioni per PC
Goditi una fantastica grafica con risoluzione fino a 4K, HDR con supporto per funzionalit tra cui monitor ultrawide e frame rate sbloccato: cacciare i mostri sar un'esperienza davvero coinvolgente. I cacciatori avranno accesso immediato anche a una serie di aggiornamenti gratuiti del titolo che includono nuovi mostri, missioni, equipaggiamento e tanto altro.


Goditi una nuova entusiasmante avventura ambientata nel villaggio di Kamura
Questo luogo sereno  abitato da un variegato cast di personaggi che hanno vissuto a lungo nella paura della Furia, un evento catastrofico in cui il villaggio  preso di mira da un'orda pericolosa di mostri. 50 anni dopo l'ultima Furia, la tua missione sar collaborare con gli abitanti del villaggio per superare questa prova.


Vivi nuove avventure con gli Insetti filo
Gli Insetti filo sono parte integrante del kit del tuo cacciatore. La speciale seta che sparano pu essere usata per spostarsi rapidamente sui muri e lungo la mappa, oltre a poter sferrare attacchi speciali per ognuna delle 14 tipologie di armi del gioco.


I compagni sono qui per aiutare
Gli amici Felyne che hai gi avuto modo di apprezzare nelle precedenti avventure di Monster Hunter saranno affiancati dai nuovissimi Canyne!


Riporta l'ordine controllando i mostri
Doma pericolosi mostri con la Cavalcatura wyvern e infliggi enormi danni ai tuoi bersagli!


Respingi orde di mostri nella Furia
Proteggi il villaggio di Kamura da orde di mostri in un nuovissimo tipo di missione! Preparati a cacciare i mostri come mai prima d'ora!

title: Monster Hunter Stories
description:
Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG that takes the world of Monster Hunter and expands upon it in new and exciting ways! No longer are you hunting monsters, but raising them! In this deep story featuring heroes known as Monster Riders, you will live alongside monsters and form lifelong bonds with them. The first installment of the Monster Hunter Stories series returns, fully voiced in Japanese and English, with additional features such as a new museum mode where you can listen to music and view concept art, allowing you to dive even deeper into the world of Monster Hunter Stories.

Story:

As the hero of the story, you were born in a village of Riders who raise monsters for a living. You’ll overcome trials and tribulations as you grow as a Rider, and leave your village to embark on an adventure. Your destination: the world of Hunters, who make their living by hunting monsters. Although their lifestyles are vastly different, you must learn to live and work together with Hunters, and in turn, bring the world of Hunters and Riders ever closer.

Things take a dark turn as a calamity known as the Black Blight appears, threatening the entire world and upending peaceful lives that were taken for granted... Both Riders and Hunters alike will be put to the test in order to challenge this threat.

The keys to saving the world are the Kinship Stone and its hidden power, along with the truth of the “Legend of Redan,” which describes the long-kept secret of the Riders’ origins! Along your epic journey, you will discover the true meaning of Kinship, which grows as your bonds deepen! A story of friendship and triumph await you—ride on into the world of Monster Hunter Stories!

Game Features:

  • A turn-based RPG set in the world of Monster Hunter! Monster Hunter Stories features a strategic battle system which is easy to get the hang of, even for those who struggle with action games. Use Power, Speed, and Technical attacks to guess and overcome your opponent's attack patterns to inflict heavy damage and win head-to-head battles! Build up your Kinship Gauge to use skills or try your Monsties' unique Kinship Skills!
  • Turn popular monsters from the series into your Monsties! Explore the field using Monstie abilities, hatch eggs that you find along the way, and turn various monsters into Monsties! This game features many popular monsters from the Monster Hunter series, including Zinogre, Nargacuga, and Lagiacrus. Also featured is the Rite of Channeling, a ritual which awakens dormant abilities in your Monsties, allowing you to raise original Monsties and take on powerful enemies!
  • Online features that allow you to create a powerful party with the Monsties you have raised and enjoy battles with other players!

New Features:

  • Fully voiced in Japanese and English! The narrative is even more immersive with full Japanese and English voices.
  • Bonus Museum content! Enjoy more than 200 pieces of concept art, including some which have never been seen before, as well as numerous music tracks. Some tracks are being featured in surround sound for the first time!
  • All updates are included! You will find all the monsters added in updates to the original game, such as Kushala Daora, Teostra, and Rajang, as well as expanded endgame content and additional character editing parts, making this the complete package!

title: Monster Train
description:
Hell has frozen over. Only you can protect the final burning pyre from the forces of heaven and restore the inferno. Monster Train brings a new strategic layer to roguelike deck building, with three vertical play fields to defend.

Visit powerful locations

To take back hell, you?ll need to power up. Choose your route carefully, different locations give different benefits; upgrade your champion, recruit powerful units, upgrade cards, gain passive bonuses or duplicate any card in your deck.


Strategize to fit your playstyle

With five clans to choose from, each has its own unique and surprising gameplay. Pick your primary and supporting clan to gain access to all cards from both. During your run you will be able to improve cards by mixing and matching upgrades to open up new roads to victory. You can even duplicate your favourite card at special map nodes before facing off against the final boss.

No playthrough is ever the same

You?ll never play the same deck twice!
  • Over 220 cards, build up your deck from 10 different starterdecks
  • 5 monster clans with each very different gameplay
  • Each clan has 10 levels to unlock, bringing new cards to your deck
  • Upgrade your clan specific champion multiple times
  • Mod support through Steam Workshop
  • Upgrade any card twice
  • More than 21 unique random events
  • 25 covenant (difficulty) levels

Multiplayer


HELL RUSH
In the Hell Rush multiplayer mode, eight players compete in a frantic real time contest. Each player has the same resources and opponents to create a level playing field.
